SUBJECT: R. H. Kehrweyn - Application for License to carry firearms.
R. H. Kehrweyn, Austrian, until recently holding a German Passport, was born at Vienna on May 19th, 1894.
S.M.P. records contain no reference to this person. The following is a brief account of his life as told by him to a member of the Special Branch.
In 1917, during the Great War, he was a Lieutenant in the Austrian Army fighting on the Russian border and was captured by the Russians. He spent a year in a Siberian prison camp but was released when the Armistice was signed. He made his way to Shanghai and after a few days proceeded to America. Being an Engineer by profession and interested in Aviation, then more or less in its infancy, he eventually succeeded in obtaining employment at various aircraft firms and later became a pilot. After about four years at this he worked at the Ford Plant in Detroit for one year. Following this he was engaged by Pan-American Airways and the American Aircraft Corporation as a "Blind-flying Instructor." He married an American girl in 1922 and has a daughter now aged about eighteen. Whilst employed with the American Aircraft Corporation he flew all over South America, Europe and parts of Asia.
In 1940, he went with his daughter to Italy to have her voice trained. Whilst in Genoa, his permit to return to the U.S.A. was cancelled by the U. S. Immigration Authorities. After the present European War started, Germans leaving the U.S.A. were not allowed

R. H. Kehrweyn，奥地利人，直至最近仍持有德国护照，1894年5月19日出生于维也纳。
工部局警务处档案中无此人记录。以下是他向特别分部成员所述的生平简述。
1917年，大战期间，他在奥地利军队服役，军衔为中尉，在俄边境作战时被俄军俘虏。他在西伯利亚战俘营度过了一年，但在停战协定签署后获释。他辗转来到上海，几天后前往美国。作为一名工程师，他对当时尚处于萌芽阶段的航空业颇感兴趣，最终成功在多家飞机公司受雇，后来成为飞行员。从事该职业约四年后，他在底特律的福特工厂工作了一年。此后，他被泛美航空公司（Pan-American Airways）和美国飞机公司（American Aircraft Corporation）聘为“盲飞教官”。他于1922年娶了一位美国女子，现有一女，年约十八岁。受雇于美国飞机公司期间，他的足迹遍布南美洲、欧洲和亚洲部分地区。
1940年，他携女儿前往意大利接受声乐训练。在热那亚期间，美国移民局取消了他返回美国的许可。随着当前欧洲战争的爆发，离开美国的德国人不再被允许
（批注：我不反对发给手枪许可证，无需其他更正式的手续。未经其上级推荐——此人似乎尚在控制之中）
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1941年12月4日 刑事与特别分部）
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1941年12月4日 助理总监 特别分部）
（印章：档案 D.12.N1.）

1941年11月初，当他在日本时，他开始担心自己会被迫登上其中一艘在日本为德国海军装备的袭击舰。Kehrweyn 称，每艘袭击舰都携带一架小型飞机，他认为自己很可能被任命为其中一架飞机的飞行员。
他以生病和需要一流医疗救治为由，说服日本当局允许他前往上海。抵达此处后，他入住百老汇大厦（Broadway Mansions），但某晚在与一位女士应酬时，试图取回掉落在沙发后面的项链，他发现了一个隐藏的麦克风，显然是日本人放置的。因此，他搬至目前位于吴淞路转角哈同路（Hart Road）619号的住址。
当地纳粹官员坚持要求 Kehrweyn 返回日本，提醒他因未从雅典返回柏林而构成逃兵行为。由于 Kehrweyn 拒绝返回日本，此地德国领事已没收其护照。
Kehrweyn 称，他手中仍有22,000元关金现金，由于冻结令，他无法将其存入任何银行。这笔钱存放在哈同路619号，但他挑衅地表示，没人能找得到它。

SUBJECT: (4)
Since his return to Shanghai, Kehrweyn states that he has given certain information to Commanders Woolley and Sheppard of the British Naval Office. He has asked that these two names be not mentioned in any Police reports as he believes that the Nazis have heard of this and in consequence he is being followed wherever he goes and his life is in jeopardy. Hence this application for a firearms permit.
Commander Woolley was interviewed by a member of the Special Branch and it was verified that Kehrweyn had offered the British Naval Authorities certain information. This had proved worthless however and the British Authorities place little credence on Kehrweyn's information and have no faith in the man who is known to them as a dangerous person capable of double-crossing anyone with whom he has dealings.
Commander Woolley stated that it is obvious that Kehrweyn is out of favour with the Nazis and the Japanese but definitely not because of any information imparted by Kehrweyn to the British Naval Authorities. Commander Woolley thought it more likely that it is because of some commercial transaction in which Kehrweyn has come out best.
Although Kehrweyn has stated at Headquarters that he has no firearm, Commander Woolley is certain that he saw Kehrweyn with a pistol and a "Black-jack" both of which he took no trouble to conceal.

主题：(4)
Kehrweyn 称，自返回上海以来，他已向英国海军办事处的 Woolley 指挥官和 Sheppard 指挥官提供了一些情报。他要求在警方报告中不要提及这两人的名字，因为他相信纳粹已获悉此事，因此他无论走到哪里都被跟踪，生命受到威胁。故此提出持枪许可证申请。
特别分部成员约谈了 Woolley 指挥官，核实了 Kehrweyn 曾向英国海军当局提供某些情报一事。然而，这些情报被证明毫无价值，英国当局对 Kehrweyn 的情报鲜少采信，也不信任这个人，在他们看来，他是一个危险人物， capable of double-crossing anyone with whom he has dealings（能够背叛任何与他打交道的人）。
Woolley 指挥官表示，显然 Kehrweyn 已失宠于纳粹和日本方面，但绝非因为 Kehrweyn 向英国海军当局提供了任何情报。Woolley 指挥官认为，更可能的原因是 Kehrweyn 在某笔商业交易中占了上风。
尽管 Kehrweyn 在总部声称他没有枪支，但 Woolley 指挥官确信他曾看见 Kehrweyn 携带一把手枪和一个“黑杰克”（Black-jack，一种包铅皮的短棍或软鞭），且他毫不费力地暴露了这些物品。
